sources: arXiv initial-submission metadata and benchmark discovery searches
official benchmark protocols, implementation files and dataset descriptions
official leaderboard methodology and validator corrections
inclusion_rule: Reusable benchmark or evaluation contribution with a public primary source and a measurement object inside the Radar scope. Methods without a distinct evaluation contribution are excluded.
note: Bounded primary-source discovery covered Agent Memory, RAG / Agentic Retrieval, and Data Agents through 2026-11-17 (UTC+8); this is not an exhaustive census. Three new identities completed protocol/results review. Citation refresh, source-result verification and discovery dates remain separate. Existing citation counts were retained; new citation lookups were rate-limited (HTTP 429), so counts remain unknown. No benchmark experiments were reproduced.
